## Goal
`tests/copilot/test_cp_source_citations.py` checks `file.py:NNN` citations in `docs/user/` only. WO-302, WO-303 and WO-306 add citations to `docs/USER_GUIDE.md`, `docs/CLI.md` and `FAMILY_QUICK_START.md`; guard those too.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- For each `file.py:NNN` citation in those three files: the file resolves to exactly one file under `src/freemyid/`, line NNN exists, and any quoted text on the same line appears in that file (also as Python joins adjacent string literals).
- Doesn't fail when a file has no citations yet (today none of the three has any).
- Fake cases in `tmp_path`: a missing file, a line past the end, an ambiguous file name and quoted text not in the source each fail.
- Same rules as the copilot test, so a writer meets one standard; the docstring says which file is the reference.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Test rules: one new file, prefix `test_gk_`. Typed Python 3.11+, ruff-clean (100-character lines), standard library plus pytest only (no new dependencies). Read repo files with `pathlib` from `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]`; write only to `tmp_path`. No network, no subprocess, no running the app. Don't create `tests/grok/__init__.py` (WO-305 lists it) or a `conftest.py`; keep helpers in your file. Fake cases (strings or `tmp_path` files) prove the guard both flags and passes. It must pass on current main: a real problem in a file this WO may not edit is a strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Name the existing guard you checked and the gap you cover in the module docstring.
